cleanupPrompt: Use case: background-extraction. Edit target: the attached 2x2 four-boss spaceship sprite sheet. Change ONLY background alpha and framing. Preserve all FOUR exact spaceship identities, colors, armor details, number of weapon heads, downward facing directions and 2x2 cell order. Remove ALL white/gray matte, milky haze, fuzzy outer glow and any colored fringe around or behind the hulls. All empty space including holes between arms must be truly TRANSPARENT with zero alpha, not white, gray or checkerboard painted pixels. Opaque solid hulls, including white/ivory armor, must stay fully opaque. Do not erase pale ship armor. Keep only the four crisp clean spaceship cutouts. Reduce each ship within its own square cell so its complete silhouette has a generous 12-percent transparent margin on every side of that cell; restore any tiny cut-off tip if necessary. No object crosses or touches cell boundaries. Exactly two columns and two rows. No shadows on a backdrop, no stars, no effects, no text, no scenery, no redesign.
